pages.text: You obtained a cauldron from the Nether Piglins. Right-click to open its internal storage and fill it with a brew. While equipped in a trinket slot, pressing the activate trinket key (default: G) triggers the brew's effect once without consuming it, after which the trinket enters cooldown. The more effects and the stronger the brew, the longer the cooldown.
If you don't like its appearance, you can switch its texture on a Cursed Infuser.
